split_rule: First four France fixtures fit counts; fifth fixture checks probabilities, both teams. Match events already inspected in earlier work; this is not fresh validation.
features: Starting grid cell only; same fixed 6x4 geometry. No xT zone values, endpoints, pass outcomes or test counts as prediction features.
labels: Missing pass-outcome label = completed; Incomplete/Out/Pass Offside = unsuccessful; Unknown/Injury Clearance/other labels excluded. Existing selected non-restart possession-team pass sample.
smoothing_rule: (training zone completions + strength * global training completion rate) / (training zone attempts + strength)
baseline: Global training completion rate for every check pass
interpretation: A zone-context estimate, not a conditional completion model for a specific passing option. Strength 20 fixed for this exercise, not tuned on check results.
